en: A black‑and‑white historic street scene in a European city, showing a wide boulevard lined with multi‑story 19th‑century buildings with ornate facades and shops at street level. Horse‑drawn carriages, early trams, and many pedestrians fill the cobblestone street. In the far distance, a large arched façade closes the perspective, while on the right stands a tall, narrow building with a spired tower. The top of the image has a V‑shaped missing section, suggesting damage or cropping typical of an old postcard or glass negative reproduction.
